text: Understanding databases is important for anyone working with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which look like spreadsheets with rows and columns. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents. To get information from a database, you write queries, which are special instructions for finding data. Data modeling helps you plan how your data will be organised before you build anything. Finally, indexes make searches faster by helping the database find information quickly, just like an index in a book.
